svg.title: Circle 2 and cross off its other multiples
svg.desc: A ten-by-ten grid lists 1 through 100. The number 2 is circled. The number 1 and every other even number are crossed off. Odd numbers greater than 1 remain unmarked and have not yet been classified.

g.text: Circle 2 and cross off its other multiples
1 is not prime, and every even number greater than 2 has 2 as a factor.
Unmarked numbers are not yet classified. The number 1 is neither prime nor composite.
